audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and cooldowns said 'track Apprehend' without ever giving its cooldown, and called Feast 'your committal tool'.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s at only 535 range — by a wide margin the longest cooldown in his kit and the single number that makes this lane playable. Decimate is 9/8/7/6/5s and Noxian Guillotine 120/100/80s. Advice that omits the 26s is throwing away the whole punish window.
audit.corrected: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 and only 535 range — a whiffed pull is your entire window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interaction line read 'His all-in start. Q-peel after it.' Nothing about what his abilities actually do or what your kit does to them.
audit.why: Three real interactions were missing. Feral Scream's silence prevents Noxian Guillotine being cast at all, and champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json separately flags Rupture as shutting off the Guillotine leap. Decimate heals him only off the outer blade — standing at the handle denies the heal entirely, which inverts the usual instinct to back away from a melee wind-up. And Noxian Guillotine's cooldown refreshes on a killing blow, so a low health bar next to a dying wave is a chain-kill setup, not a single trade.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream stops Noxian Guillotine casting; hug the handle of Decimate so the blade half cannot heal him; his R refreshes on a kill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The don'ts list never mentioned Hemorrhage stacks.
audit.why: Five stacks enrage him for a large attack-damage bonus, and Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with the stack count on you. The correct rule is to break off the trade before the fifth stack lands, which is a timing no cooldown chart shows.
audit.corrected: Five Hemorrhage stacks enrage him and feed Guillotine — break off before the fifth.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of the Crippling Strike tell.
